```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "", echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(width = 140, scipen = 999)
```

This is a working notebook, not a report. It runs the same engine the site uses
(`replication/R/segment_model.R`) on the same file (`data/synthetic_enrollment.csv`)
and prints every intermediate table along the way. The site reads its numbers from
`src/data/computed.json`, which `replication/R/export_site_data.R` writes. The last
section checks that file against what is calculated here.

Settings used throughout:

- Data cutoff (`DATA_DATE`): 2025SP. This is the last term with an entering class in the CSV.
- Population: undergraduates, all entry types, one matrix per school.
- MCM: 3 terms per year (summer, fall, spring), 12 terms tracked, offset 2 for fall returns.
- MCC: 2 terms per year (fall, spring), 8 terms tracked, summer rows dropped, offset 1.
- Rates: simple mean of per-cohort ratios, a cohort counted only if both cells are above 0,
  COVID terms excluded, no cap. These are the 2025 notebook defaults.

Rows are terms since entry (d), columns are cohorts (term_int). Cells are distinct students enrolled.
Cells past the data cutoff are still filled here because the CSV has records past 2025SP; the
rate and projection functions ignore them.

## Observed portion only (cells at or before 2025SP)

```{r observed-only}
mask_obs <- function(m, tpy) {
  cs <- as.integer(colnames(m)); m <- m[, cs <= DATA_DATE, drop = FALSE]; cs <- as.integer(colnames(m))
  for (j in seq_along(cs)) for (k in 0:(nrow(m) - 1L)) if (cal_term(cs[j], k, tpy) > DATA_DATE) m[k + 1L, j] <- NA
  colnames(m) <- int_to_term(cs); m
}
mask_obs(m_mcm, 3L)
mask_obs(m_mcc, 2L)
```

# 7. Continuation rates

Rate at step d = mean over cohorts of (heads at d) / (heads at d - offset), by entry season.

## MCM

```{r mcm-rates}
r_mcm      <- segment_rates(m_mcm, 3L, DATA_DATE)
r_mcm_cov  <- segment_rates(m_mcm, 3L, DATA_DATE, exclude_covid = FALSE)
r_mcm_3yr  <- segment_rates(m_mcm, 3L, DATA_DATE, years = 3)
round(r_mcm, 6)
round(r_mcm_cov, 6)
round(r_mcm_3yr, 6)
```

Difference, COVID included minus excluded:

```{r mcm-rates-diff}
round(r_mcm_cov - r_mcm, 6)
```

How many cohorts went into each MCM fall-entrant rate (no COVID):

```{r mcm-rate-n}
n_used <- function(m, tpy, s, exclude_covid = TRUE) {
  cs <- as.integer(colnames(m))
  sapply(1:(nrow(m) - 1L), function(k) sum(sapply(which(season(cs) == s), function(j) {
    cal <- cal_term(cs[j], k, tpy)
    if (cal > DATA_DATE || (exclude_covid && cal %in% COVID_TERMS)) return(FALSE)
    m[k + 1L, j] > 0 && m[k + 1L - ref_offset(cs[j], k, tpy), j] > 0
  })))
}
n_used(m_mcm, 3L, "FA")
n_used(m_mcm, 3L, "SP")
```

Per-cohort ratios behind the MCM fall-entrant rate at each step (the mean of each row is the rate):

```{r mcm-ratios}
ratios <- function(m, tpy, s) {
  cs <- as.integer(colnames(m)); js <- which(season(cs) == s)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(m) - 1L, length(js), dimnames = list(1:(nrow(m) - 1L), int_to_term(cs[js])))
  for (k in 1:(nrow(m) - 1L)) for (i in seq_along(js)) {
    j <- js[i]; cal <- cal_term(cs[j], k, tpy)
    if (cal > DATA_DATE || cal %in% COVID_TERMS) next
    a <- m[k + 1L, j]; b <- m[k + 1L - ref_offset(cs[j], k, tpy), j]
    if (a > 0 && b > 0) out[k, i] <- a / b
  }
  round(out, 4)
}
ratios(m_mcm, 3L, "FA")
ratios(m_mcm, 3L, "SP")
```

# 10. Charge, aid, net per term

The CSV has `ntr` and `institutional_grant`. Gross is taken as ntr + grant. The generator's fee is
already inside ntr, so the comprehensive fee is set to 0 to avoid counting it twice.

Rows used: fall entrants in their entering term.

```{r money}
money <- function(r) {
  er <- r[r$term_code == r$cohort_term & grepl("FA$", r$cohort_term), ]
  charge <- mean(er$ntr + er$institutional_grant)
  c(rows = nrow(er), mean_ntr = mean(er$ntr), mean_grant = mean(er$institutional_grant),
    charge = charge, charge_rounded = round(charge),
    aid_rate = mean(er$institutional_grant) / charge,
    net = round(charge) * (1 - round(mean(er$institutional_grant) / charge, 6)))
}
round(money(mcm_r), 6)
round(money(mcc_r), 6)
```

Spread of the inputs:

```{r money-spread}
summary(mcm_r$ntr); summary(mcm_r$institutional_grant)
summary(mcc_r$ntr); summary(mcc_r$institutional_grant)
summary((mcm_r$institutional_grant) / (mcm_r$ntr + mcm_r$institutional_grant))
```

Mean ntr by term, all MCM undergraduate records (to see whether price moves over time):

```{r ntr-by-term}
x <- tapply(mcm_r$ntr, mcm_r$term_code, mean)
round(x[order(names(x))])
```

# 11. Four-year NTR per entering class (the calculator)

Same arithmetic as `computeEntrantProjection` in `src/utils/calculator.ts`, at the default inputs
(no retention shift, multiplier 1). Student-terms are summed over the first 4 years
(d = 0 to 11 on MCM, 0 to 7 on MCC). Aid percent is rounded to 2 decimals, as the calculator's
input box does.

```{r calculator}
calc <- function(r, rates, tpy, entering) {
  mo <- money(r); charge <- unname(mo["charge_rounded"])
  aid_pct <- round(round(unname(mo["aid_rate"]), 6) * 100, 2)
  net <- charge - charge * aid_pct / 100
  # rebuild the curve from the 6-decimal rates the site stores, without rounding (as the calculator does)
  rr <- round(ifelse(is.na(rates[-1, "FA"]), 0, rates[-1, "FA"]), 6)
  p <- numeric(length(rr) + 1); p[1] <- 1
  for (k in seq_along(rr)) p[k + 1] <- p[k + 1 - ref_offset(term_to_int("2025FA"), k, tpy)] * rr[k]
  yrs <- data.frame(year = 1:4)
  yrs$student_terms <- sapply(1:4, function(y) entering * sum(p[(y - 1) * tpy + 1:tpy]))
  yrs$entry_heads <- sapply(1:4, function(y) round(entering * p[(y - 1) * tpy + 1]))
  yrs$ntr <- yrs$student_terms * net
  yrs$gross <- yrs$student_terms * charge
  yrs$aid <- yrs$student_terms * charge * aid_pct / 100
  list(inputs = c(entering = entering, charge = charge, aid_pct = aid_pct, net_per_term = net),
       years = yrs,
       totals = c(student_terms = sum(yrs$student_terms), ntr = sum(yrs$ntr),
                  ntr_per_entrant = sum(yrs$ntr) / entering, year1_share = yrs$ntr[1] / sum(yrs$ntr),
                  y2_fall_retention = p[tpy + 1]))
}
c_mcm <- calc(mcm_r, r_mcm, 3L, unname(ent_mcm["2025FA"]))
c_mcc <- calc(mcc_r, r_mcc, 2L, unname(ent_mcc["2025FA"]))
c_mcm
c_mcc
```

The curve here is rebuilt from the 6-decimal rates in `computed.json` without rounding, the same way
the calculator builds it. The 4-decimal `persistence_curve` in section 8 gives totals a few thousand
dollars different.

# 12. Census projection, 2025SU to 2026FA

Unobserved cells are filled with (reference cell) x (rate for that step and entry season). The census
is the sum along each calendar-term diagonal.

## MCM

```{r proj-mcm}
p_mcm <- project_segment(m_mcm, r_mcm, 3L, DATA_DATE, ent_mcm)
round(p_mcm$heads, 1)
h_mcm <- headcount_by_term(p_mcm)
h_mcm[h_mcm$term %in% c("2024FA", "2025SP", "2025SU", "2025FA", "2026SP", "2026SU", "2026FA"), ]
```

Only cohorts 2021FA and later reach these census terms within 12 steps. Contributions to 2025FA:

```{r contrib-mcm}
contrib <- function(p, term) {
  cs <- as.integer(colnames(p$heads)); out <- c()
  for (j in seq_along(cs)) for (k in 0:(nrow(p$heads) - 1L))
    if (int_to_term(cal_term(cs[j], k, p$tpy)) == term)
      out <- rbind(out, data.frame(cohort = int_to_term(cs[j]), d = k, heads = round(p$heads[k + 1L, j], 2),
                                   observed = p$observed[k + 1L, j]))
  out
}
contrib(p_mcm, "2025FA"); sum(contrib(p_mcm, "2025FA")$heads)
contrib(p_mcm, "2026FA"); sum(contrib(p_mcm, "2026FA")$heads)
```

Census NTR at the net per term from section 10:

```{r census-ntr-mcm}
net_mcm <- c_mcm$inputs[["net_per_term"]]
x <- h_mcm[h_mcm$term %in% c("2025SU", "2025FA", "2026SP", "2026SU", "2026FA"), ]
x$ntr_m <- round(x$heads * net_mcm / 1e6, 2); x
```

## MCC

```{r proj-mcc}

round(p_mcc$heads, 1)
h_mcc <- headcount_by_term(p_mcc)
h_mcc[h_mcc$term %in% c("2024FA", "2025SP", "2025FA", "2026SP", "2026FA"), ]
```

## Longer horizon, for reference (not on the site)

```{r long-horizon}
h_mcm[grepl("FA$", h_mcm$term) & h_mcm$term >= "2025FA", ]
h_mcc[grepl("FA$", h_mcc$term) & h_mcc$term >= "2025FA", ]
```

Past 2026FA every census is a mix of placeholders and projections, and the matrix only tracks 12 (MCM)
or 8 (MCC) terms per cohort, so older cohorts drop out of the sum.

# 13. Backtest

Rates estimated with data through 2023FA. Entering classes after that set to their actual sizes.
Projected census compared with the actual census from the same matrix (same d limit).

```{r backtest}
backtest <- function(m, tpy, cut_term, check_terms) {
  cut <- term_to_int(cut_term)
  r <- segment_rates(m, tpy, cut)
  cs <- as.integer(colnames(m)); later <- cs[cs > cut & cs <= DATA_DATE]
  ent <- setNames(m[1, as.character(later)], int_to_term(later))
  pr <- headcount_by_term(project_segment(m, r, tpy, cut, ent))
  ac <- headcount_by_term(project_segment(m, segment_rates(m, tpy, DATA_DATE), tpy, DATA_DATE))
  out <- data.frame(term = check_terms,
                    projected = pr$heads[match(check_terms, pr$term)],
                    actual = ac$heads[match(check_terms, ac$term)])
  out$error_pct <- round(100 * (out$projected - out$actual) / out$actual, 1)
  out
}
backtest(m_mcm, 3L, "2023FA", c("2024SP", "2024SU", "2024FA", "2025SP"))
backtest(m_mcc, 2L, "2023FA", c("2024SP", "2024FA", "2025SP"))
```

Same check from an earlier cutoff:

```{r backtest-early}
backtest(m_mcm, 3L, "2022FA", c("2023SP", "2023SU", "2023FA", "2024SP", "2024SU", "2024FA", "2025SP"))
backtest(m_mcc, 2L, "2022FA", c("2023SP", "2023FA", "2024SP", "2024FA", "2025SP"))
```

The synthetic generator uses stable rates, so these errors are smaller than real data would give.

# 14. Compare with the site's data file

`src/data/computed.json` is what the site reads. Each value below is recalculated here and compared.

```{r compare}
j <- jsonlite::fromJSON("src/data/computed.json", simplifyVector = TRUE)
j$source
chk <- function(label, site, here, tol = 1e-6) {
  ok <- length(site) == length(here) && all(abs(as.numeric(site) - as.numeric(here)) <= tol)
  data.frame(item = label, match = ok)
}
z <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x)
rbind(
  chk("records", j$source$records, nrow(d), 0),
  chk("students", j$source$students, length(unique(d$student_id)), 0),
  chk("MCM FA rates", j$entrant$schools$MCM$rates, round(z(r_mcm[-1, "FA"]), 6)),
  chk("MCM SP rates", j$cohort_matrix$MCM$spRates$noCovid, round(z(r_mcm[-1, "SP"]), 6)),
  chk("MCM FA rates with COVID", j$cohort_matrix$MCM$rates$withCovid, round(z(r_mcm_cov[-1, "FA"]), 6)),
  chk("MCC FA rates", j$entrant$schools$MCC$rates, round(z(r_mcc[-1, "FA"]), 6)),
  chk("MCC SP rates", j$cohort_matrix$MCC$spRates$noCovid, round(z(r_mcc[-1, "SP"]), 6)),
  chk("MCM curve", j$entrant$schools$MCM$curve, pc_mcm_fa$persistence),
  chk("MCC curve", j$entrant$schools$MCC$curve, pc_mcc_fa$persistence),
  chk("MCM entering", j$entrant$schools$MCM$entering, ent_mcm[["2025FA"]], 0),
  chk("MCC entering", j$entrant$schools$MCC$entering, ent_mcc[["2025FA"]], 0),
  chk("MCM charge", j$entrant$schools$MCM$charge_per_term, money(mcm_r)[["charge_rounded"]], 0),
  chk("MCC charge", j$entrant$schools$MCC$charge_per_term, money(mcc_r)[["charge_rounded"]], 0),
  chk("MCM aid rate", j$entrant$schools$MCM$aid_rate, round(money(mcm_r)[["aid_rate"]], 6)),
  chk("MCC aid rate", j$entrant$schools$MCC$aid_rate, round(money(mcc_r)[["aid_rate"]], 6)),
```

Cohort counts in the inspector against the matrix:

```{r compare-cohorts}
cmp_cohorts <- function(jc, m) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(jc)), function(i) {
    ct <- jc$cohortTerm[i]; ob <- jc$observed[[i]]
    if (length(ob) == 0) return(data.frame(cohort = ct, entrants = jc$entrants[i], cells = 0, match = NA))
    ks <- as.integer(names(ob)); heads <- sapply(ob, function(o) o$heads)
    data.frame(cohort = ct, entrants = jc$entrants[i], cells = length(ks),
               match = all(heads == m[ks + 1L, as.character(term_to_int(ct))]))
  }))
}
jj <- jsonlite::fromJSON("src/data/computed.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
as_df <- function(cl) data.frame(cohortTerm = sapply(cl, `[[`, "cohortTerm"),
                                 entrants = sapply(cl, `[[`, "entrants"),
                                 observed = I(lapply(cl, `[[`, "observed")))
cmp_cohorts(as_df(jj$cohort_matrix$MCM$cohorts), m_mcm)
cmp_cohorts(as_df(jj$cohort_matrix$MCC$cohorts), m_mcc)
```
